name: departures
title: Departures review
for_each: select id,code from comparisons order by code

sections.title: Changes and decisions
sections.note: A recorded decision does not alter the source document. Imported text remains the vendor report wording.
sections.sql: select ordinal,location,kind,before_text,after_text,report_text,source_tag,source_note,decision,review_note,reviewer from change_register where comparison_id=$1 order by ordinal

name: signoff
title: Comparison review record
for_each: select id,code from comparisons order by code

sections.title: Review decisions
sections.sql: select c.ordinal,d.decision,d.note,d.actor,d.created_at from decisions d join changes c on c.id=d.change_id where c.comparison_id=$1 order by d.sequence

sections.title: Signoffs
sections.note: Each signoff applies only to its recorded revision. It is not approval to send or sign the underlying agreement.
sections.sql: select revision,actor,evidence,created_at from signoffs where comparison_id=$1 order by revision
